analysis_md:
$\Omega$ 即 $\begin{cases}0\leq\theta\leq 2\pi\\0\leq\varphi\leq\pi\\1\leq r\leq 2\end{cases}$，

原式 $=\iiint_\Omega z^2\,dv+\iiint_\Omega z\,dv=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^\pi d\varphi\int_1^2r^2\cos^2\varphi\cdot r^2\sin\varphi\,dr+0$

$=2\pi\int_0^\pi\cos^2\varphi\sin\varphi\,d\varphi\cdot\int_1^2r^4\,dr=\frac{62}{5}\pi(-\frac{\cos^3\varphi}{3})\big|_0^\pi=\frac{124}{15}\pi$。
